# MEVSpace Provider

Manage MEVSpace (mevspace.com) dedicated servers and SSH keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    mevspace = {
      source = "onnimonni/mevspace"
    }
  }
}

# Token from https://panel.mevspace.com, or set MEVSPACE_API_TOKEN
provider "mevspace" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) MEVSpace API access token. Can also be set with MEVSPACE_API_TOKEN.
- `endpoint` (String) API endpoint. Defaults to https://api.mevspace.com or MEVSPACE_ENDPOINT.
